mapper.insert: INSERT INTO friend_link (name, site_url, icon_url, description, contact, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{siteUrl}, #{iconUrl}, #{description}, #{contact}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM friend_link ORDER BY status ASC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM friend_link WHERE status = 'APPROVED' ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM friend_link WHERE site_url = #{siteUrl}
mapper.update: UPDATE friend_link SET status = 'APPROVED', reject_reason = NULL, reviewed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE friend_link SET status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = #{reason}, reviewed_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
